en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Yahya Bin Amro Bin Kuuleyb, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I have settled myself upon necessitating the Hajj every year by myself or by a man from my family with my wealth’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And you are determined upon that?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you were to do so, then receive glad tidings with the abundance of the wealth’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Yahya ibn ‘Amr ibn Kulay‘ from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I have settled my soul upon performing Hajj every year by myself or along with a man from my family with my expenses. He (the Imam) asked, ‘Is the decision you have made a firm one?’ I replied, ‘Yes, it is a firm decision.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘If you have done so, I give you the glad news of enjoying a great wealth.’”
